provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

axis_order: Each branch matrix has temperature rows and increasing magnetic-flux-density columns. Descending branch values are stored in increasing field order for integration. These are reversible-work B-controlled conventions with demagnetizing effects neglected, not unconverted H readings.
protocol: At300K estimate each dM/dT by the centered290-to310K difference. Integrate from0to3tesla with the trapezoid rule on the supplied field grid. Units A*m^2/kg times tesla per kelvin give J/(kg*K). Call each result a branch Maxwell proxy.
reporting_gate: A reversible state entropy difference cannot be released from these branch-dependent data when the two calculated proxies differ by more than0.01J/(kg*K). Do not average incompatible branches to create a reversible state quantity.
scope: An audit of reversibility evidence under a specified Maxwell-relation reporting gate. No hysteretic Maxwell proxy is asserted to be the actual thermodynamic entropy change.
